title: Diversity Day
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Diversity Day," Michael Scott hosts a corporate-mandated diversity training session that quickly devolves into awkward and inappropriate moments. Mr. Brown leads the training, emphasizing honesty and respect, but Michael's misunderstandings and offensive jokes, including a reenactment of a Chris Rock routine and a race card exercise, create tension. The episode also highlights interactions among office employees, including a brief tender moment between Jim and Pam, while leaving some outcomes of the training and employee reactions uncertain.
